intent: A gothic widow's gown of charcoal cloth and an ash-grey veil, bone-laced at the waist with its tiered bell skirt burnt to ragged, violet-glowing tongues; from the high camera it reads as a narrow-shouldered, ash-crowned A-line.
requests: A sheer or translucent cloth material for the veil; Fabric renders the ash veil as a solid slab.
A tapered skirt-panel shape; boxes can only step the bell outward in tiers, so the flare reads as stacked tiers rather than one smooth cone.
